# ICU4C (vendored, in part, as /usr/lib/libicucore.A.dylib)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | ICU4C: International Components for Unicode for C/C++ |
| Upstream | <https://github.com/unicode-org/icu> |
| Version | 79.1 (release of 2026-10-22) |
| Archive | `https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/download/release-79.1/icu4c-79.1-sources.tgz`, 28,162,455 bytes, SHA-256 `06fa63ecb521048f8082f12ad988f6b678d90cbd88aafce24cbc94902b191d99` (matches the GitHub release asset digest) |
| License | Unicode-3.0, with the third-party notices it contains (`LICENSE`, copied verbatim; identical to the release's `LICENSE` asset) |
| Files | `LICENSE`; from `source/common/`, the 68 sources the exports need (the members a static link of the whole library pulls in for them) and every header of `source/common/` and `source/common/unicode/` (including the compiled-in Unicode property, case-mapping and NFC tables); `source/data/in/uts46.nrm` (UTS #46 normalization data, a prebuilt upstream data file). The i18n, io and tools libraries, the other data, the tests and the build system are not vendored |
| Modifications | None. Copied by `python -I scripts/vendor_files.py <archive> third_party/icu --strip icu/ LICENSE 'source/common/*.h' 'source/common/unicode/*.h' source/data/in/uts46.nrm source/common/<module>.cpp...` (the module list is in `scripts/build_alchemy_icu.ps1`). The configuration is in the build script's defines; `runtime/icu/` holds the project's own time-zone declarations and the data-package generator |

Use: built by `scripts/build_alchemy_icu.ps1` as `/usr/lib/libicucore.A.dylib` (compatibility version 1.0.0,
current version 79.1.0), exporting the UTF-8 conversion, case-mapping and string functions and UTS #46 IDNA under
unversioned names, as Apple's libicucore does. See `docs/ALCHEMY_OSS_RUNTIMES.md`.

To update: download the new release, check the digest and the licence, rerun the copy command (adding any module the
new release's link needs), build, run the `alchemy_icu_runtime` test, and update this file, the build script's pins
and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
